title: Base Write Multiple Coils variant 4
purpose: Use a conservative complete FC0F exchange with a small multi-coil payload, preserving correct quantity, byte count, and response shape for baseline mutation utility.
expected_behavior: A conforming peer would typically acknowledge the starting address and quantity written when the request is acceptable.
constraints_preserved: 7-byte MBAP header used in both messages
Request MBAP length 0008 matches unit identifier plus 7-byte fixed PDU and 2 data bytes
Response MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte response PDU
Function code 0f matches the named Write Multiple Coils operation
Quantity 000a and byte count 02 are internally consistent
issue_safety_notes: Model-prior conservative seed only. This sequence is intended for parser and mutator coverage, not to imply any issue relevance.
